custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu lists, from top to bottom, "Cycle count", "Deactivate parts" and "Export" (3 entries).
  • "Activate parts" is not in it.

Step 2:

  • The menu closes.

Step 3:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 4:

  • The menu lists "Cycle count", "Activate parts" and "Export".
  • "Deactivate parts" is not in it.

Step 5:

  • The menu closes.

Step 6:

  • The Active tab is selected.

Step 7:

  • The menu again lists "Cycle count", "Deactivate parts" and "Export".

Step 8:

  • Bulk mode turns on: a dark bar appears under the tabs and a checkbox column appears at the left of the list.

Step 9:

  • Bulk mode ends: the bar and the checkbox column disappear.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk), story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R1: “Bulk deactivation is a mode. The user turns it on from the Inventory actions menu, the three-dot button in the toolbar that holds Cycle count and Export.”
  • S2-R2: “The menu entry reads "Deactivate parts" while the Active tab shows and "Activate parts" while the Inactive tab shows. Only one of the two shows at a time. It sits between Cycle count and Export.”
  • S3-R1: “Reactivation uses the same mode as Story 2. On the Inactive tab the actions menu entry reads "Activate parts", and turning it on shows the same checkbox column and the same bulk bar.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: boards "4.1 The actions menu", "4.6 Inactive tab, Activate parts".
